utility.primary_scope: Original validation A: all15 known/no_answer parents and all45 candidates, including the original masked candidate; unknown5 stays nullable audit. Preserve role20 total. The same exposed development validation also selects epochs, so utility is regression evidence, not unbiased generalization.
utility.comparator_tie: Minimum total checks over one complete control; ties keep fixed array order. Stable candidate-score ties keep original candidate position. No per-request stitched best control.
utility.oracle_explanation: Ten answerable requests contribute1 each; five no_answer requests require all2+2+2+2+3 candidates, contributing11. Do not assume every request has three candidates.
utility.fixed_denominator_integer_implication: If the unchanged strongest control is27 checks, a5% reduction requires at most25 checks, with Top1 at least5 and Top3 at least10. This is arithmetic, not a new threshold.

utility.no_headroom_claim: The new slice's control counts are unmeasured. If a control already reaches its oracle, report zero available headroom on that slice; do not claim learned gain or use it to lower/replace the fixed original-validation gate.
utility.checks_meaning: Simulated independent checks from acceptable rank+1, or all candidates for no_answer. Not actual verifier executions, LLM calls, CPU instructions or measured Codex cost.

resources.timeout_policy: Kill the process group and wait/reap; preserve partial durable counters/results and report uncertain in-flight calls rather than success or zero.
resources.storage_enforcement_note: PLAN56 defines a total new-data/models/numeric-record budget. First71 validates AssetsMax and caps individual pinned input reads but its execute writer has no visible cumulative new-file byte accounting. For the next run, root must sum newly written governed assets against the same64MiB ceiling; do not call a per-file cap aggregate enforcement or silently raise the budget.
resources.distinctions: File bytes, owned sparse payload, temporary JSON allocations, Go heap/allocations and OS RSS are different.256MiB GOMEMLIMIT is soft; the old outside controller measures RSS and reports budget status after exit, not an enforced RSS kill. Whole lifetime wall/user/system/RSS includes startup, validation, controls, checkpoints and model I/O. No per-score latency, GPU savings or LLM cost claim.
resources.models_policy: Weights and binary assets remain private and outside Git. Preserve failed71/72 originals. New HF publication, default activation, quantization and production readiness are separate later actions after the original utility/reproducibility/license/resource conditions; this plan does none.
